# Jutsu Hero

> Free, browser-based rhythm game where players perform Naruto-style hand seals via webcam, recognized in real time by a computer-vision model (MediaPipe Hands + a custom ONNX classifier). No download, no account, no backend required.

Jutsu Hero is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project. It is not affiliated with, authorized, or endorsed by Masashi Kishimoto, Shueisha, Studio Pierrot, VIZ Media, or Bandai Namco. Naruto is the property of its respective owners.

## How it works

- MediaPipe Hands tracks 21 hand landmarks from the webcam feed at ~30fps.
- A custom-trained ONNX classifier predicts which of the 12 zodiac hand seals the player is forming.
- Correct sequences (e.g. Ne → Saru → Mi → Inu for Kage Bunshin no Jutsu) trigger a jutsu, dealing damage in battle modes.
- Everything runs client-side in the browser; no camera access is required thanks to a full keyboard fallback (keys 1-8).

## Game modes

- Single Player — practice hand seals against the clock.
- Local Battle — two players, split-screen, same device.
- Online Battle — create a room, share a short code, and fight in real time from separate devices (1v1 or 4-player battle royale) over a self-hosted Socket.io server.
